title: Could you please release a smaller model
body: Hi, the released 7B model cost > 24GB GPU memory for its inference. Could you please release a smaller one?
author: ztianlin

comments.body: @ztianlin We hear you. In our next major update of Predict, we will include a smaller model.

title: Have an option to download av sample along
body: Currently, the download script will force you to download the transfer model, the AV sample, and the upscaler. I think it will be better if we can provide options for users to download precisely what they want, like what we have in cosmos-predict1.
author: mingyuliutw

title: Does the inference must run on H100？
author: MingyuLau

comments.body: No, we also tested on A100, it works fine. The latest repo supports multi-GPU inference, which should allow the code to run on lower end GPUs.

title: GPU Memory Requirements and Tips for Reducing VRAM Usage
body:
Hi! Thanks for the great work!

I'm trying to run the following code:

`
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export CHECKPOINT_DIR="${CHECKPOINT_DIR:=./checkpoints}"
CUDA_HOME=$CONDA_PREFIX PYTHONPATH=$(pwd) python cosmos_transfer1/diffusion/inference/transfer.py \
    --checkpoint_dir $CHECKPOINT_DIR \
    --video_save_folder outputs/robot_sample \
    --controlnet_specs assets/robot_sample_spec.json \
    --offload_text_encoder_model
`

I was wondering:

- Approximately how much GPU memory is required to run this?
- Is there a chance it could run on a single RTX 4090?
- Are there any recommended ways to reduce memory usage? For example, can reducing the video resolution help?

Thanks in advance! ❤️
author: haoyangli16

comments.body: Wondering the same thing, what exactly are the minimum hardware requirements?

Hi,

The current published code has been tested on H100, and we provide few flags to offload certain models during runtime to reduce memory usage. If you run your command by adding `--offload_text_encoder_model --offload_guardrail_models --offload_diffusion_transformer`  flags like below:

```
PYTHONPATH=$(pwd) python cosmos_transfer1/diffusion/inference/transfer.py \
 --checkpoint_dir $CHECKPOINT_DIR \
 --video_save_folder outputs/robot_sample \
 --controlnet_specs assets/robot_sample_spec.json \
 --offload_text_encoder_model --offload_guardrail_models --offload_diffusion_transformer
```

The peak memory usage would go down to ~38GB. This means you’d need A6000 or higher cards to do inference.

To run on lower memory GPUs, we’d need to explore other techniques like quantization. We’ll keep you updated when we have any updates.

title: nvidia/Cosmos-Tokenize1-CV8x8x8-720p vs nvidia/Cosmos-1.0-Tokenizer-DV8x16x16
body: the repository expects `nvidia/Cosmos-Tokenize1-CV8x8x8-720p`, however, huggingface access is granted to `nvidia/Cosmos-0.1-Tokenizer-DV8x8x8`. the two versions do not seem interchangeable since `nvidia/Cosmos-0.1-Tokenizer-DV8x8x8` is missing `mean_std.pt`
author: mosure

comments.body: @mosure How were you able to solve this?

I cloned `nvidia/Cosmos-1.0-Tokenizer-CV8x8x8` into `nvidia/Cosmos-Tokenize1-CV8x8x8-720p` manually, after running the checkpoint download script. it is unclear if this degrades performance but the diffusion inference pipeline runs.
